description: List products recently added to Tangerine Index that are new: their first reaction (a Hacker News, Product Hunt or GeekNews post, or the GitHub repository's creation) came at most 7 days before they were added. Newest first by added_at. Use it to see what launched recently, optionally for a kind of tool (pass need) or form (e.g. MCP Server). To poll for new products, pass the newest added_at you have seen as since. Data refreshes once a day (as_of); products added before Nov 10, 2026 have no added_at and are not listed.

forms.description: Only return products that have ALL of these forms. 'MCP Server': the product is an MCP server (listed in the MCP Registry, or its README has an MCP client config)

need.description: Optional: narrow to products that do this, in short plain English, e.g. "coding agent"

open_source.description: true: only open-source products (GitHub repositories); false: only the others

period_days.description: Look at products added to the index in the last 3, 7 (default), or 30 days

since.description: Only products added after this time, ISO 8601 (e.g. '2026-11-10' or '2026-11-10T09:00:00Z'; UTC if no zone). Pass the previous call's newest added_at to get only what is new since then

name: new_products

as_of.description: When the data was last collected (ISO 8601, UTC). Updated once a day.

added_at.description: When Tangerine Index added the product (ISO 8601, UTC). Results are newest first

first_reaction_at.description: Date of its first reaction: a post, or the GitHub repository creation

forms.description: Product forms, any of: CLI, Library, Desktop, Mobile, Browser Extension, Self-hosted, MCP Server. More may be added.

pushed_at.description: Last push to any branch of the repository, ISO 8601 UTC, as GitHub reports it

stars_as_of.description: Date of the last daily star count, 'YYYY-MM-DD' (UTC). Counts refresh once a day

stars_gained_30d.description: Stars gained in the 30 days up to stars_as_of

stars_gained_7d.description: Stars gained in the 7 days up to stars_as_of (negative if lost). Null when the daily history is shorter

link_status.description: 'dead' means the product link did not respond when last checked

page_url.description: Tangerine Index page for this product

score.description: Number reported by the source (HN: points). Never combined across sources.

score_unit.description: Unit of score in this source, e.g. 'pts'

summary.description: What it does, one line, in the original English

usage.description: Ways to install or connect, matched by repository, domain or MCP Registry namespace: MCP servers, Homebrew, npm, PyPI, crates.io. Empty when none is known. No install commands; pick one from the registry.

kind.description: 'mcp': MCP server in the official MCP Registry; 'brew'/'cask': Homebrew; 'npm', 'pypi', 'cargo': package

name.description: Name in that registry, e.g. an npm package name or an MCP server name

package.description: MCP only: package that runs the server locally, e.g. { type: 'npm', id: '@scope/server' }

remote.description: MCP only: remote (streamable HTTP or SSE) URL to connect to

scope.description: 'company': matched by domain while the product is a page on its company's site, so it covers the whole company

url.description: Registry page, or for an MCP server its remote URL, website, or repository

since.description: The since value used, normalized to ISO 8601 UTC

title: New products
